content:
I printed what you sent. Here's how it came out:
the light:
- back: the roof the hole goes through: loose loops and tangles around the hole; hole partly closed.
- the inserts: the posts around them softened and bulged as I pressed them in, and the inserts sit crooked.
- hanging it: it won't drop onto the wall screws.

Send me the design again with submit_design, changed or unchanged, and I'll print it again from what you send.

I'll resubmit with changes for the three problems you hit. I'm changing the insert bosses, the insert-bar geometry, and the keyhole. I can't check the printed result myself, so the keyhole fix is a guess at the cause.

check against your actual screws"},"kh_y":{"value":45,"kind":"design","source":"design","unit":"mm"},"kh_head_d":{"value":10,"kind":"design","source":"design","unit":"mm","note":"head clearance for 9 mm head"},"kh_shank_w":{"value":4.6,"kind":"design","source":"design","unit":"mm"},"kh_slot_len":{"value":12,"kind":"design","source":"design","unit":"mm"},"usb_w":{"value":14,"kind":"design","source":"design","unit":"mm"},"usb_z0":{"value":18,"kind":"design","source":"design","unit":"mm","note":"slot z range 18-28 covers port at 22.1-25.3"},"usb_h":{"value":10,"kind":"design","source":"design","unit":"mm"}}, "parts": [{"id":"back","role":"final","material":"PLA matte white","code":"def build(p):
    Ro = p.box_r
    Ri = Ro - p.wall_t
    H = p.depth
    tb = p.back_t
    body = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(Ro).extrude(tb)
    body = body.union(cq.Workplane('XY').circle(Ro).circle(Ri).extrude(H))
    bar_h = H - p.bar_z0
    bar = cq.Workplane('XY').box(p.bar_len, p.bar_w, bar_h, centered=(True, True, False)).translate((0, 0, p.bar_z0))
    ins_pts = [(-p.disc_hole_pitch / 2, 0), (p.disc_hole_pitch / 2, 0)]
    bosses = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.bar_z0).pushPoints(ins_pts).circle(p.boss_r).extrude(bar_h)
    post = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=tb - 0.01).circle(p.post_r).extrude(p.bar_z0 - tb + 0.5)
    body = body.union(bar).union(bosses).union(post)
    pts = [(sx * p.pb_x, p.pb_yc + sy * p.pb_y) for sx in (-1, 1) for sy in (-1, 1)]
    so = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=tb - 0.01).pushPoints(pts).circle(p.standoff_r).extrude(p.standoff_h + 0.01)
    body = body.union(so)
    pil = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=tb).pushPoints(pts).circle(p.pilot_d / 2).extrude(p.standoff_h + 1)
    body = body.cut(pil)
    ins = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=H - p.ins_len).pushPoints(ins_pts).circle(p.ins_hole_d / 2).extrude(p.ins_len + 1)
    body = body.cut(ins)
    kh_pts = [(-p.kh_x, p.kh_y), (p.kh_x, p.kh_y)]
    kh = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-1).pushPoints(kh_pts).circle(p.kh_head_d / 2).extrude(tb + 2)
    slot_pts = [(-p.kh_x, p.kh_y - p.kh_slot_len / 2), (p.kh_x, p.kh_y - p.kh_slot_len / 2)]
    slot = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-1).pushPoints(slot_pts).rect(p.kh_shank_w, p.kh_slot_len).extrude(tb + 2)
    body = body.cut(kh).cut(slot)
    usb = cq.Workplane('XY').box(p.usb_w, p.wall_t + 4, p.usb_h, centered=(True, True, False)).translate((0, -(Ro - p.wall_t / 2), p.usb_z0))
    body = body.cut(usb)
    return body
